# Spear

> Defense-in-depth security middleware for LLM I/O pipelines.

Spear guards your LLM application against prompt injection, system prompt exfiltration, PII leaks, and jailbreaks. It works as inline middleware — not a separate service.

## Packages

- @spear-secure/core: Main security runtime. npm install @spear-secure/core
- @spear-secure/hook: Claude Code PostToolUse hook. npm install @spear-secure/hook

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { quick } from '@spear-secure/core';

const spear = quick('balanced');

// Pre-gate: scan input, embed canary, sanitize
const pre = await spear.pre(messages, { sessionId });
if (!pre.allowed) return blocked();

// Your LLM call
const response = await llm(pre.messages);

// Post-gate: scan output, detect exfiltration, mask PII
const post = await spear.post({ output: response, canary: pre.canary });
```

## Key Features

- InputGate: Unicode normalization, 7-class injection detection
- InstructionShield: Role hierarchy enforcement, system prompt protection
- OutputGate: Canary exfiltration detection, PII masking, encoded leak scanning
- ToolMediator: CaMeL-inspired data provenance, capability-based tool RBAC
- Session API: Stateful multi-step agent loop security (session.step/tools/complete)
- Emergent defense: Blocks composed attacks (read_file then send_email, mid-loop goal hijack, split canary)
- Shadow mode: Observe before enforce — policy-as-code with YAML
